project.title: Space Explorer
project.summary: Space game to learn about the solar system, gravity, and orbits.

sections.title: Overview
sections.body: A browser-based space exploration game that teaches solar system concepts, gravity, and orbital mechanics through interactive simulation.

sections.title: Architecture
sections.body: Vanilla JavaScript with HTML5 Canvas for rendering. A simple physics integrator handles gravitational N-body dynamics between celestial objects.

sections.title: Planning
sections.body: Designed as an educational tool, with levels that introduce one concept at a time (gravity, escape velocity, orbital velocity).

sections.title: Demo
sections.body: Play the game and view the source on GitHub.
